name: g4
purpose: Page-by-page reading as in g3 on a 123-page check register (3,308 rows, 12 fields each; final-v1 0.0): one page image at 150 DPI with its text layer, each page's output capped at four tokens per character of its text, the other fields from one whole-document request capped at 2,048 tokens; at most 24 sequences at once; pretty-printed JSON-object answers. Qwen3.5-9B FP8.
